changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names with proper spacing, consolidated duplicate dataset names, removed redundant model variations, and added image captioning outputs since SCST and XLAN are image captioning models explicitly evaluated
Simplified all cosine similarity metrics to their core evaluation purposes (reclassification metrics remain), normalized Self-BLEU to BLEU base form, and removed redundant metric variations
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs (GPT-2) were only used as generation models, not for evaluation.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant criteria into core concepts (quality, relevance, realism) and maintained the clear human evaluation guideline question

overall_notes: The paper focuses on generating adversarial dilution text for multimodal inputs and evaluates both automated metrics and human judgments. The extraction was generally accurate but included some redundant items and inconsistent naming that needed normalization. The core NLG contribution is generating adversarial text dilutions that preserve semantic relevance while causing misclassification.
